title: Umbral rule set
description: Schema for rules/rules.yaml — the normative layer of the Umbral design system. Every rule the guide states, CI enforces, or a review cites must exist here first. Prose never states a rule this file does not also state.

version.description: Design-system version this rule set ships with. A rule moving to severity `error` is a MAJOR bump; a new rule at `warning` is a MINOR.

categories.description: Human-readable label per category, Spanish first.

id.description: Stable identifier. Never reused, never renumbered. Prose cites it, CI reports it, a PR review references it.

title.description: Spanish. States the rule as an assertion, not an instruction.

severity.description: error fails CI and blocks a release. warning is reported and must be justified. info is guidance.

rationale.description: Spanish. WHY the rule exists. A rule whose rationale cannot be written is not a rule, it is a preference.

type.description: automated: a tool decides. manual: a human follows a stated procedure. review: judgement, cited in PR review.

tool.description: The tool that actually runs this check. A rule may not name a tool that does not implement it — tools/verify_lint.py reconciles both directions.

id.description: The specific check within the tool. Must be unique across the rule set.

since.description: Design-system version the rule first appeared in.

evidence.description: Where this rule came from — a v1.0 document line, or an audit finding that motivated it. Optional but strongly preferred for rules added after v1.0.

exceptions.description: Stated, bounded exceptions. An exception written here is a decision; an exception taken silently is drift.

guide.description: Guide chapter that renders this rule, e.g. `02-color`. Phase 3 fills these in.
